description: This file contains a custom implementation of a printf() function and associated helper functions for formatted output, intended for embedded or low-level system programming where standard libraries may be unavailable. It defines internal functions, macros, and an output method used to output formatted strings character-by-character using an external 'board_putc' method.

methods.name: void lp_Print(void (* output)(void *,char *,int),void * arg,char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: A low-level printf function that processes format strings and variable arguments, handling various format specifiers like %d, %x, %s, etc., and outputs via a provided output function.

methods.name: void printf_output(void * arg,char * s,int l)
methods.description: A helper function used by 'printf' to output characters to the board by calling 'board_putc'.

methods.name: void printf(char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Public function providing formatted output similar to standard printf, utilizing 'lp_Print' and 'printf_output'.

methods.name: int PrintChar(char * buf,char c,int length,int ladjust)
methods.description: Helper to print a single character with padding and justification.

methods.name: int PrintString(char * buf,char * s,int length,int ladjust)
methods.description: Helper to print a string with specified width and alignment.

methods.name: int PrintNum(char * buf,unsigned long u,int base,int negFlag,int length,int ladjust,char padc,int upcase)
methods.description: Helper to convert and print a number in a specified base with formatting options.

ctags.signature: (char * buf,unsigned long u,int base,int negFlag,int length,int ladjust,char padc,int upcase)
